requirement_map.requirement: Define workspace and application budgets for aggregate memory, processes, CPU, storage, and competing I/O.

assertions: Kernel memory.max, memory.swap.max, pids.max, cpu.max, and io.max exist before startup.
Broker hierarchy applies workspace, actor, and application limits.
Storage owner verifies volume, domain, actor, and object quota membership.

requirement_map.source_adoption: Adopted-source operator/storage/resource checks pass in both host/profile combinations.

requirement_map.requirement: Derive effective application budgets from workspace policy, launching actor authority, and requested profile.

assertions: Application leaf CPU and I/O are bounded by actor and requested profile.
Read-only authority denies actual writes while private state stays writable.
Rejected capacity reservations leave process rows unchanged.

requirement_map.source_adoption: Adopted-source operator/storage/resource checks pass in both host/profile combinations.

requirement_map.requirement: Apply limits before releasing held application startup. Keep resource-control paths and descriptors outside the application.

assertions: Held startup observes installed limits before release.
Child sees no cgroup path or selected parent-control descriptors.
Native supervisor consumes sealed resource handoff and rejects descriptor aliases.

requirement_map.source_adoption: Adopted-source operator/storage/resource checks pass in both host/profile combinations.

requirement_map.requirement: Account for project files, Git objects, application state, cache, temporary files, and trash within bounded workspace storage.

assertions: Repository, project, and retirement subvolumes share their checked domain qgroup.
Application state and its home, cache, config, data, and tmp paths stay within the application subvolume.
The independent writer receives EDQUOT at application and actor aggregate boundaries.
Imported bytes, retained inodes, source immutability, and sibling bytes are verified across owner restart.

requirement_map.source_adoption: Adopted-source operator/storage/resource checks pass in both host/profile combinations.

requirement_map.requirement: Verify inheritance after fork, exec, detachment, and broker recovery.

assertions: Forked detached children hit one shared pids.max and increment pids.events.
Revocation terminates detached descendants without terminating independent actor execution.
Broker restart preserves completed records without replaying uncertain operations.

requirement_map.source_adoption: Adopted-source operator/storage/resource checks pass in both host/profile combinations.

requirement_map.requirement: Verify independent applications and workspaces retain usable authority after another exhausts its budget.

assertions: OOM kills the exhausted group while the sibling heartbeat advances.
Actor reservation exhaustion preserves another actor application.
Storage exhaustion in one workspace preserves a second workspace write.

requirement_map.source_adoption: Adopted-source operator/storage/resource checks pass in both host/profile combinations.

requirement_map.requirement: Use independent bounded exhaustion and escape witnesses on both hosts in Debug and runtime sanitizers.

assertions: Six child namespaces differ from host namespaces.
Capabilities, no_new_privs, seccomp, descriptor closure, and explicit environment are independently checked.
Host paths, symlink escape, host process environment, abstract sockets, and prohibited syscalls fail.
Kernel CPU throttling and actual I/O bytes confirm aggregate enforcement.

requirement_map.source_adoption: Adopted-source operator/storage/resource checks pass in both host/profile combinations.

requirement_map.requirement: Qualify issuer availability and safe recovery under bounded competing writes. Preserve durable commit ordering.

assertions: Three acknowledged issuer policy revisions are independently read from its durable database during bounded writes.
Actor revocation stops all pinned application processes during an outstanding Git import.
Credential revocation releases input while actor-owned execution continues.
Nested execution returns BUSY and creates no file or process row.
Filesystem futures join before descriptor or path ownership ends. SQLite stays on the broker thread.

requirement_map.source_adoption: Adopted-source operator/storage/resource checks pass in both host/profile combinations.

requirement_map.requirement: Run the complete M03 phase gate after focused implementation checks pass.

assertions: Both hosts finish every registered suite in Debug and ASan/UBSan.
All 151 locked acceptance cases execute with the independent native witness.
Harness and production bounded-storage integration finish in both profiles.
Eight production cross-host delay/crash scenarios preserve cancellation, barrier, recovery, and exact cleanup checks.
Frozen source, locked inputs, binary pins, sanitizer logs, and independent measurements are reviewed.

requirement_map.source_adoption: Adopted-source operator/storage/resource checks pass in both host/profile combinations.

review_rule: Inspect actual current candidate results and independent measurements for each assertion. Source review identifies the mechanism, not runtime completion. Missing, failed, blocked, or unrun checks stay incomplete.
additional_gate_layers: Both hosts in Debug and ASan/UBSan.
All 151 locked P00-P10 cases with an actual independent native witness.
Source and binary pins, preserved failures, reviewable origin checkpoint.
later_requirements: M04-M16 and physical/native GPU acceptance remain separate. M03 completion does not complete Spatial-M1.
collector: local/m03-completed-profile-collector-02.py; archives known kernel measurements and verifies frozen binary pins.

qualification_scope: M03 only. Spatial-M1, M04-M16, physical-input/performance gates, and full LOCAL_READY remain incomplete.
limitations: The ordinary sb16 checkout has preserved local modifications. Qualified source lives in a dedicated worktree on each host.
The original killed issuer initializer remains untraced. The bounded setup policy correction is qualified; its success does not establish the original cause.
SQLite remains on the broker thread. This qualification does not claim atomicity across filesystem, Git, process, X, and SQLite effects.
The effective Git worker memory cap is 256 MiB under the tested hierarchy. The requested larger standalone limit is not the effective cap.
